entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Whisper, murmur, wheeze, rattle; Scream, yell, shriek
entries.zh: 低语、轻声细语、喘鸣、喉中咯咯声；尖叫、大喊、尖厉叫声。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Loud, big, strong, booming, thunderous, deafening, piercing, theatrical; Quiet, soft, gentle, mild, calm; Low, low-pitched, deep; High, squeaky, shrill, high-pitched, harsh; Dry, rough, hoarse, husky, croaky, scratchy, throaty; Smooth, sweet, musical, lilting, chirpy, sing-song; Bossy, whining, smug, mocking, wheedling, simpering, monotonous; Pleasant, silky, creamy, sweet, syrupy; Educated, cultured, drawling
entries.zh: 响亮、宏大、有力、洪亮、雷鸣般、震耳欲聋、尖锐、戏剧化；安静、轻柔、温柔、温和、平静；低声、低音调、低沉；高、吱吱的、尖厉、高音调、刺耳；干涩、粗糙、嘶哑、沙哑、蛙鸣般、刮擦般、喉音重；圆润、甜美、悦耳、轻快抑扬、欢快、歌唱般；专横、哼哼抱怨、自鸣得意、嘲弄、哄劝、忸怩、单调；悦耳、丝滑、醇厚、甜美、甜腻；有教养、文雅、拖长腔调。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Echoed, vibrated, drilled, droned; Cracked, croaked, clicked, gurgled, rasped; Shouted, snarled, barked, growled; Yelled, boomed, thundered, bellowed; Hissed, whispered, muttered, mumbled, murmured; Whined, whimpered, simpered, bleated
entries.zh: 回响、振动、钻入、单调低吟；破音、嘶哑地说、咔哒响、咯咯响、刺耳地说；喊叫、咆哮、厉声喝斥、低吼；大叫、轰鸣、雷鸣般说话、怒吼；嘶声说、耳语、嘟囔、含糊地说、轻声说；哀诉、呜咽、忸怩地说、咩咩般抱怨。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: ‘Don’t move,’ he urged in a croaky whisper.
entries.zh: “别动。”他用嘶哑的低语急切地说。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: ‘I didn’t do it,’ she screamed in a high-pitched, whining voice.
entries.zh: “不是我干的！”她用尖高的、带哭诉腔的声音叫道。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His voice was thunderous and seemed to vibrate in his chest.
entries.zh: 他的声音如雷鸣，仿佛在胸腔里振动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert found it difficult to pay attention to her low, droning voice and drifted off to sleep.
entries.zh: 她低沉单调的声音让罗伯特无法集中注意力，他慢慢睡了过去。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He closed his eyes and tried to block out her squeaky whimper.
entries.zh: 他闭上眼睛，努力隔绝她尖细的呜咽。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a thick, drawling accent that made it difficult to understand what he wanted her to do.
entries.zh: 他口音浓重，又拖长腔调，让她很难听懂他要她做什么。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a big, booming voice, which echoed around the room as if he was speaking through a loudspeaker.
entries.zh: 他的声音浑厚洪亮，在屋里回响，像通过扩音器说话。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He spoke in a rich, theatrical voice, as if he was acting on a stage.
entries.zh: 他说话嗓音饱满，充满戏剧感，仿佛站在舞台上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He turned and stomped out of the room, unable to listen to her simpering voice any longer.
entries.zh: 他再也受不了她忸怩做作的声音，转身重重踏步走出了房间。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: When she yelled, her voice was high and harsh, like the shriek of a seagull.
entries.zh: 她叫起来声音又高又刺耳，像海鸥的尖叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The words floated out of her mouth as a soft, feathery whisper.
entries.zh: 话语像羽毛般轻柔的耳语，从她口中飘出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her voice was as quiet and soft as velvet.
entries.zh: 她的声音像天鹅绒一样轻柔。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He spoke in a deep voice that was calm and as smooth as silk.
entries.zh: 他说话声音低沉平静，像丝绸一样顺滑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a pleasant, educated accent that inspired trust.
entries.zh: 他悦耳而有教养的口音让人产生信任。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty had a lilting, musical voice, which made the words dance in his ears.
entries.zh: 基蒂的声音轻快悦耳，让话语仿佛在他的耳畔跳舞。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was difficult to know where he was from, as he spoke without a trace of an accent.
entries.zh: 他说话没有明显口音，因此很难判断他来自哪里。
